problem_statement: TLS/DTLS socket credentials are not validated when configured on a socket via the TLS_SEC_TAG_LIST socket option. Currently setting the secure tag list succeeds regardless of whether the referenced credentials are valid, so misconfigured or malformed certificates, private keys, PSKs (without a matching PSK ID), or entirely missing credentials are only discovered much later, at handshake time, producing confusing errors that do not reveal that the local configuration was the problem. Setting TLS_SEC_TAG_LIST on a TLS/DTLS socket should validate the referenced credentials immediately: a malformed certificate or private key should be rejected with EINVAL, a PSK configured without a matching PSK ID should be rejected with EINVAL, and a tag that has no associated credential at all should be rejected with ENOENT.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/socket/tls -s tests/net/socket/tls/net.socket.tls -s net.socket.tls -O twister-out --no-clean -W
